dialogue.content: こんにちわ。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello. It's a pleasure to speak with you today.

dialogue.content: ご準備が整いましたらお知らせ下さいね。
dialogue.English: Please let me know when you're ready.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to it.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: It's my pleasure.

dialogue.content: では始めさせて頂きますね
dialogue.English: Then, shall we begin?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談員です。本日はご相談にお越しいただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: どのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What brings you in today?

dialogue.content: 人を信じられなくて、誰にも心を許せません
dialogue.English: I can't trust people, so I can't open my heart to anyone.

dialogue.content: それはとても苦しいお気持ちを抱えておられますよね。
dialogue.English: That must be a very painful feeling to carry.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そう思ったいきさつがあれば、聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: If you're comfortable, could you tell me what led you to feel that way?

dialogue.content: 今まで何度も裏切られて来て、誰も信じることができなくなりました
dialogue.English: I've been betrayed so many times in the past that I can't trust anyone anymore.

dialogue.content: 友達にも、夫にも。。。
dialogue.English: By my friends, and even my husband...

dialogue.content: それは、お辛かったですね・・。
dialogue.English: That must have been so difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 話せることからでいいので、内容を聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: You can start with whatever you're comfortable sharing. Could you tell me more about it?

dialogue.content: １０年以上付き合って、親友と思っていた友達が、実は裏で私の悪口をいっていたことや、、、
dialogue.English: A friend I'd known for over 10 years, who I thought was my best friend, was actually bad-mouthing me behind my back...

dialogue.content: それは・・ひどい
dialogue.English: That's... awful.

dialogue.content: 長年付き合って来た友達が突然、返事をしてこなくなったり、、、
dialogue.English: And friends I'd known for a long time suddenly stopped replying to me...

dialogue.content: 夫も何年も前から不倫してました。
dialogue.English: And my husband had also been having an affair for years.

dialogue.content: 突然連絡がこない・・さみしくなりますね。夫さんは何年も前から・・。
dialogue.English: Suddenly, no contact... that must feel so lonely. And your husband, for so many years...

dialogue.content: ここで、恐れ入りますが
dialogue.English: I'm sorry to interrupt, but

dialogue.content: お名前と、年齢を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: could you please tell me your name and age?

dialogue.content: 42歳、幸子です
dialogue.English: I’m Sachiko, and I'm 42 years old.

dialogue.content: 幸子さんありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you, Sachiko.

dialogue.content: 色々心が痛くなるような出来事があったんですね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you've been through a number of very painful experiences.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 色々思う事があると思うので、話の途中でも構わないので思いをここで吐き出してくださいね
dialogue.English: I'm sure you have a lot on your mind, so please feel free to express your feelings here at any time, even if it's in the middle of talking about something.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: まず、友達と夫さん、どちらの、お話しをお聞きしていきましょうか。
dialogue.English: To start, would you like to talk about your friends or your husband?

dialogue.content: 夫の不倫が分かった時も、本当は友達に相談したかったんですが、もう信用できないので、話せなくて、、、
dialogue.English: When I found out about my husband’s affair, I really wanted to confide in my friends, but I couldn't because I no longer trust them.

dialogue.content: 誰にも言えずにずっと悩んできました
dialogue.English: I've been struggling with this all by myself, unable to tell anyone.

dialogue.content: 誰も頼る人がいません
dialogue.English: I have no one to rely on.

dialogue.content: そうですよね！一人でこんな大きな問題を抱えて来られたんですね
dialogue.English: I understand. You've been carrying such a heavy burden all by yourself.

dialogue.content: 夫さんは、いつごろから、不倫ときづかれたのですか？
dialogue.English: When did you first realize your husband was having an affair?

dialogue.content: 2ヶ月前にLINEを見て気付いたんですが、もう３年くらい続いていたみたいです
dialogue.English: I found out two months ago when I saw his LINE messages, but it seems to have been going on for about three years.

dialogue.content: 夫とは離婚しようと思っています
dialogue.English: I'm thinking of divorcing my husband.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね！もう幸子さんの心は決まってる感じですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Does it feel like your mind is already made up, Sachiko?

dialogue.content: そうですね、、、離婚後の生活に不安はありますが、もう一緒に生活するのは無理です
dialogue.English: I think so... I'm anxious about life after the divorce, but it's impossible for us to live together anymore.

dialogue.content: もう無理って思うのですね。その気持ちには揺らぎはない感じですね？
dialogue.English: So you feel it's impossible. It sounds like you're firm in that feeling, is that right?

dialogue.content: ３年も裏切られてたので、、、
dialogue.English: Because I was betrayed for three years...

dialogue.content: ええ、知ったときはお辛かったし、そう決断するまで、葛藤や、怒りや色々あったでしょうね
dialogue.English: Yes, it must have been so painful when you found out, and I imagine you went through a lot of conflict, anger, and other emotions before reaching this decision.

dialogue.content: 夫は私が許してくれるのなら、やり直したいって言いますが、信用できません
dialogue.English: My husband says he wants to start over if I'll forgive him, but I can't trust him.

dialogue.content: 夫さんはそうおっしゃってるんだけど、幸子さんは信用できないんですね
dialogue.English: So, your husband is saying that, but you feel you can't trust him, Sachiko.

dialogue.content: あなたなら信用できますか？そう努力したほうがいいですか？
dialogue.English: If it were you, would you be able to trust him? Should I try to?

dialogue.content: 夫さんの不倫された状態や諸々を把握できていないので、そこを聴いた上で私なら判断しますが、
dialogue.English: Since I don't fully understand the situation and all the circumstances of your husband's affair, I would make a judgment only after hearing more, but

dialogue.content: 幸子さんは夫さんの不倫の背景、お聞かせねがえますか？
dialogue.English: Sachiko, could you tell me about the background of your husband's affair?

dialogue.content: 決して許されることではないですよ！ただ、自分の中で納得してりこんしたいですよね
dialogue.English: It's by no means something to be excused! But I imagine you want to divorce with a sense of closure for yourself, right?

dialogue.content: 不倫に状況とかあるんですか？よく、男の浮気のひとつやふたつしょうがないって言いますけど、、、そうなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are there really 'circumstances' when it comes to an affair? People often say it can't be helped if a man has an affair or two... is that really true?

dialogue.content: しょうがないって事で済まされる問題ではないですよね
dialogue.English: It isn’t a problem that can just be dismissed as 'something that can't be helped,' is it?

dialogue.content: 例えば、ですが
dialogue.English: For example,

dialogue.content: 夫さんと、不倫相手の方が一緒になっても、もう未練はないほど、夫への愛が無くなったとかならば、幸子さんが次の未来に羽ばたいて欲しいなって思うのです
dialogue.English: if your love for your husband has faded to the point where you would have no lingering feelings even if he got together with the other person, then I would want you to fly towards your own future.

dialogue.content: すごく傷ついてるんです。。不倫してた３年の間も尽くしてたんです。それなのにずっと裏切られてきたので、もう彼に対する気持ちは元に戻りません。なので気持ちの上では離婚は決定してます。ただ、生活に不安はあるということです。
dialogue.English: I'm deeply hurt. I was devoted to him during those three years he was having an affair, and yet I was being betrayed the whole time. My feelings for him will never go back to how they were. So, emotionally, the divorce is a done deal. It's just that I'm anxious about how I'll support myself.

dialogue.content: ええ、幸子さんを裏切った三年間は大きいですよね。幸子さんを悲しませた夫さんに、私が友達なら押しかけて怒りをぶつけたい。そんな話し合いとか、怒りをぶつけたりはされたのですか？その辺をスッキリさせないと、次の生活も不安が残ると感じますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: Yes, those three years of betrayal are significant. If I were your friend, I'd want to go confront your husband and vent my anger for hurting you. Have you had that kind of discussion, or been able to express your anger to him? I feel that if you don't get some closure on that, the anxiety will carry over into your next chapter. What do you think?

dialogue.content: 離婚に向けて話し合いはしています。
dialogue.English: We are having discussions about the divorce.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。話し合いを進めて、離婚して、次に進みたい。ただ、人を信用できない不安感だけが残ってるんですね？
dialogue.English: I see. So you want to move forward with the discussions, get divorced, and move on. But this feeling of anxiety and being unable to trust people is what remains, is that right?

dialogue.content: そうですね。心を許して話せる人がいません。
dialogue.English: That's right. There's no one I can open up to.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、心を許して想いをぶつけられないんですよね
dialogue.English: I understand. You feel you can't let your guard down and pour out your feelings to anyone.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうして、思いをぶつけられないと思いますか？
dialogue.English: Why do you think it’s hard to pour out your feelings?

dialogue.content: 信用できないからです。思いをぶつけるというより、話を聞いて欲しいという感じです
dialogue.English: Because I can’t trust people. It’s less about venting and more that I want someone to listen.

dialogue.content: 話しても大丈夫と思える人がいないからです
dialogue.English: Because there’s no one I feel safe talking to.

dialogue.content: 誰も幸子さんの話を聴いてくれないとお感じなんですね。大丈夫と思える人が居ないと感じる程に心を痛めておられるんですね
dialogue.English: So you feel like no one will listen to you. You've been hurt to the point where you feel there's no one you can feel safe with.

dialogue.content: 感じるというより、いないんです。実際に
dialogue.English: It's not a feeling, it's a fact. There really is no one.

dialogue.content: 許せる人が居ないなと思うのはどれくらい前からですか？
dialogue.English: How long have you felt that there's no one you can trust?

dialogue.content: 親友が悪口言ってるって知ったのが２年くらい前です。もともと信用できる友達はそんなにいないし、
dialogue.English: I found out my best friend was badmouthing me about two years ago. To be honest, I didn't have many trustworthy friends to begin with.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そんな事もあったんですね。
dialogue.English: So you went through that as well.

dialogue.content: 初めにお話ししましたよね、、、？
dialogue.English: I mentioned that at the beginning, didn’t I...?

dialogue.content: ええ、色々想いを話しても欲しいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, and I would like you to feel free to share whatever else is on your mind.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、お子さんはいらっしゃるんですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, do you have any children?

dialogue.content: 4歳の子がいます
dialogue.English: I have a four-year-old.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、お子さんの事も考えないといけなかったりで、ほんと、今、お苦しい状態が伝わります
dialogue.English: I see. Having to think about your child on top of everything else... I can really sense how painful and difficult your situation is right now.

dialogue.content: 幸子さんのご両親とはいかがですか？話など出来ていますか？
dialogue.English: How about your parents, Sachiko? Are you able to talk with them?

dialogue.content: 父は亡くなり、母には心配するので話せません
dialogue.English: My father has passed away, and I can’t talk to my mother because she would worry.

dialogue.content: お母さんには心配かけたくないんですね。育児の相談とかはどのようにされていますか？
dialogue.English: So you don't want to worry your mother. How do you get support with parenting concerns?

dialogue.content: ママ友とかには話すかな、、？
dialogue.English: I guess I talk to other moms...?

dialogue.content: ママ友との関係はどのようにお感じですか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel about your relationships with the other moms?

dialogue.content: あまり深入りはしてません。世間話とか子供のちょっとしたこととか
dialogue.English: I don't get too close. We just make small talk or chat about little things related to the kids.

dialogue.content: ええ、深入りしないようにされてるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you make a point of not getting too close.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そこも信用できない気持ちと関係ありますか？
dialogue.English: Is that also related to your feelings of not being able to trust people?

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: I suppose so.

dialogue.content: ご自分でも心を許して話が出来なくて、でも本当は許して話したいんですよね
dialogue.English: So you find yourself unable to open up and talk with people, but deep down, you really want to, don't you?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 時間も押してきたのですが、思いを話してもいいですか？
dialogue.English: Our time is running short, but may I share a thought with you?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: とても、傷つく出来事があった為、幸子さんは心にガードやロックをかけてしまわれてるんですよね。でも、それが、今、苦しいと気づかれていて、何とかしたい。何とかするのも自分の心なのですが、
dialogue.English: Because of the very hurtful things that happened, you've put guards and locks around your heart. But now you're realizing that this is causing you pain, and you want to do something about it. And while making that change comes from within your own heart, but...

dialogue.content: ガードを解除するには、
dialogue.English: to unlock those guards,

dialogue.content: 幸子さんを決して誰も傷つけようとしていないと、思って頂きたいなと
dialogue.English: I'd like you to consider the idea that not everyone is out to hurt you.

dialogue.content: ・・時間が押してきたので、申し訳ありません
dialogue.English: ...I'm sorry, our time is running short.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 話を続けたいので、また、ここへいらして下さりますか？
dialogue.English: I'd like to continue this conversation, so would you be willing to come back again?

dialogue.content: 幸子さんのお力になりたいのです
dialogue.English: I truly want to help you, Sachiko.

dialogue.content: そうですね。。機会があったらきてみます。
dialogue.English: I see... I'll try to come again if I have the chance.

dialogue.content: ご自分を意思をしっかり持った幸子さんのお話をお聞きしたいので、お待ちしております。
dialogue.English: You are a person with a strong will, Sachiko, and I want to hear more of your story. I'll be waiting for you.

dialogue.content: 長くなってしまい申し訳ありません。今日はここで終了させて頂きますが、大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry for running a bit long. We'll end here for today, is that alright?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございます。勉強になりました)では、終了ボタンを押しますね。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: (Thank you. This was a learning experience.) I’ll press the end button now. Thank you.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)
